title: Country Music Hall of Fame, RCA Studio B, Hatch Show Combo Ticket
includes: Create and take home your own commemorative souvenir poster from Hatch Show
Access to all exhibits (current exhibits include Dolly Parton, Kenny Chesney, and many others)
See examples of printed posters created for the Grand Ole Opry, Ryman Auditorium, and more!
See the Steinway piano that Elvis favored during your tour of RCA Studio B
Admission to the Country Music Hall of Fame® and Museum
1-Hour Guided Tour of RCA Studio B
Visit the famed Rotunda, where the plaques of all Country Music Hall of Fame members reside

requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
See three of Nashville's Top Attractions with this exclusive combo ticket, including admission to the Country Music Hall of Fame® and Museum, RCA Studio B, and the Hatch Show Print Tour. Enjoy the Country Music Hall of Fame® on this self-guided tour of the museum, exploring artifacts highlighting the evolution of Country Music. 
Stop by the legendary RCA Studio B, where Elvis, Dolly, and others recorded numerous hits, with a guided 1-hour tour of the studio. End your day with a 1-hour tour of Nashville's Hatch Show Print located at the Country Music Hall of Fame® and create your own vintage commemorative poster to take home.

It is highly recommended to contact the Country Music Hall of Fame & Museum prior to visiting to finalize your reservation for guaranteed entry.
